versions.subject: Merge PR #5528 from @MATTANDERS0N - add rules for defense evasion
versions.detection:
selection_cmdlet:
    CommandLine|contains: 'Set-MpPreference'
selection_action:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '-LowThreatDefaultAction'
        - '-ModerateThreatDefaultAction'
        - '-HighThreatDefaultAction'
        - '-SevereThreatDefaultAction'
        - '-ltdefac '
        - '-mtdefac '
        - '-htdefac '
        - '-stdefac '
selection_value:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'Allow'
        - '6'
        - 'NoAction'
        - '9'
condition: all of selection_*
